venues.csv.name: City unofficial venue name, not a verified Paralympic competition site
venues.csv.centerlineMiles: Street centerline miles; already rounded by page
venues.csv.totalRamps: Corners inventoried, including missing ramps; not installed-ramp count
venues.csv.missingPct: Percentage of inventoried corners missing a ramp

barrier_sites.csv.curbRampsNoted: Raw page value; zero means none noted, not proof of no ramp
barrier_sites.csv.loggedOn: Page-reported date, not repair completion date

GIS.geometry: GeoJSON longitude/latitude WGS84; no geocoding or routing inferred
GIS.dates: ArcGIS date attributes remain Unix epoch milliseconds, null remains null
GIS.domains: Coded field meanings retained in raw/*_metadata.json
GIS.street_segments.csv: Attributes only; full lines in street_segments.geojson
GIS.live_barrier_points: Raw source records, not merged; can exceed page grouped-site count

provenance.page_snapshot_date: Date claimed by page, not collection date
provenance.page_dataset_updated_date: StreetsLA venue dataset date claimed by page, not all-layer freshness
provenance.verification: Page claims remain unverified unless noted
